common.asking_claude_this_takes_a_little: Asking Claude. This takes a little while…

away.these_keep_going_while_im_away: These keep going while I'm away
away.tick_what_you_still_want_to: Tick what you still want to be nudged about, like pills.

backup.the_settings_would_change_like_this: The settings would change like this:
backup.this_install_does_not_have_everything: This install does not have everything the file points to.
backup.they_are_kept_but_do_nothing: They are kept, but do nothing until you pick devices that exist here.
backup.save_a_copy_of_what_i: Save a copy of what I have now first
backup.keep_it_somewhere_private_it_holds: Keep it somewhere private: it holds the names of your devices and your notes.
backup.this_file_is_too_big_to: This file is too big to be a Boopli backup.
backup.this_is_not_a_boopli_backup: This is not a Boopli backup file.
backup.the_file_ends_in_and_is: The file ends in {EXTENSION} and is plain text inside. It holds the names of your devices and phones and your notes, so keep it private. Running chores, away mode and picture files are not part of it.
backup.runs_ending_one: {count} running chore belongs to chores that are not in the file and will end.
backup.runs_ending_other: {count} running chores belong to chores that are not in the file and will end.
backup.importing_replaces: Importing replaces the ticked parts on this install, and it cannot be undone.
backup.every_chore_with_its_steps_questions: Every chore with its steps, questions and schedule.
backup.the_rooms_of_my_home_and: The rooms of My home and their notes.
backup.your_pets_level_and_xp_and: Your pet's level and XP, and what was done.

breakdown.room_notes_the_ai_will_see: Room notes the AI will see:
breakdown.what_the_ai_sees_today_from: What the AI sees today (from your photos). Change anything that is wrong:
breakdown.the_photos_are_already_gone_this: The photos are already gone. This text goes with the questions and the steps, and is not saved afterwards.
breakdown.add_photos_of_how_it_looks: Add photos of how it looks now (optional)
breakdown.to_split_tasks_into_small_steps: To split tasks into small steps, switch on AI help and choose your Home Assistant AI agent. It takes a minute, and Boopli never sends anything before you do.
breakdown.time_to_wait_before_this_step: Time to wait before this step
breakdown.questions_asked_each_time_you_start: Questions asked each time you start this chore
breakdown.today_it_may_look_different_than: Today it may look different than next week. Steps that belong to a question only show up when you answer yes.
breakdown.kept_with_the_chore_for_next: Kept with the chore, for next time (you can edit it)
breakdown.a_long_note_was_shortened_to: A long note was shortened to keep the request small.
breakdown.you_can_try_again_or_skip: You can try again, or skip the questions.
breakdown.the_agent_has_to_be_able: The agent has to be able to read images. You can pick another one for photos in Settings, under AI help, Advanced.
breakdown.you_stopped_waiting_your_task_and: You stopped waiting. Your task and answers are still here, so you can try again.
breakdown.there_is_no_step_yet_add: There is no step yet. Add one, or try again.
breakdown.what_is_the_chore_i_will: What is the chore? I will ask what it really involves, so we can break it into tiny steps once and reuse them every time.
breakdown.what_do_you_want_to_get: What do you want to get done? Write it the way you would say it.
breakdown.take_or_pick_up_to_photos: Take or pick up to {MAX_PHOTOS} photos. They go once to the helper you pick below (your AI agent, or Claude), which writes down what is out of place. Boopli keeps no photo: you see the text it wrote, and only that text is used.
breakdown.what_you_told_me_so_far: What you told me so far ({length})
breakdown.worth_about_xp_when_all_are: · worth about {xp} XP when all are done. Check them, change what does not fit.
breakdown.tip_tell_boopli_about_your_rooms: Tip: tell Boopli about your rooms and the steps will fit them.
breakdown.a_few_more_things_so_the: A few more things, so the steps fit.
breakdown.a_few_questions_so_the_steps: A few questions so the steps fit your situation.
breakdown.claude_asks_left_one: Ask Claude uses your Claude routine: {count} ask left this hour. Each question round and the steps are one ask each.
breakdown.claude_asks_left_other: Ask Claude uses your Claude routine: {count} asks left this hour. Each question round and the steps are one ask each.

chore_editor.each_day_has_its_own_times: Each day has its own times. Untick a day that has none.
chore_editor.a_status_light_can_mean_something: A status light can mean something: pills red, laundry blue. This color wins over the colors set in ladders. Without one, the nudge's or the light's own color is used. Lights that cannot show colors ignore it.
chore_editor.question: Question
chore_editor.delete_it_and_anything_in_progress: Delete it, and anything in progress?
chore_editor.set_the_schedule_step_by_step: Set the schedule step by step
chore_editor.the_step_stays_quiet_with_no: The step stays quiet, with no nudges, until one of these happens, for example your washing machine's "cycle finished" event. Then it is your turn. The minutes above become the longest it waits.
chore_editor.asked_every_time_you_start_this: Asked every time you start this chore, because things look different each time. A step you link to a question is only in the list when you answer yes.
chore_editor.give_the_chore_a_name_first: Give the chore a name first, so the AI knows what to split up.
chore_editor.longest_it_waits_0_as_long: Longest it waits (0 = as long as it takes):
chore_editor.nudge_even_in_quiet_hours_for: Nudge even in quiet hours (for example pills)
chore_editor.keeps_going_while_im_away_for: Keeps going while I'm away (for example pills)
chore_editor.every_n_days_after_i_finish: Every N days after I finish

chores.a_quick_look_first_so_the: A quick look first, so the list only has what needs doing today.
chores.no_chores_yet_pick_a_template: No chores yet. Pick a template above or create your own.

claude.where_the_routine_sends_its_answer: Where the routine sends its answer
claude.it_must_be_reachable_from_the: It must be reachable from the internet, and allowed in the routine's environment.
claude.leave_empty_to_use_home_assistants: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's external URL
claude.token_saved_boopli_keeps_it_out: Token saved. Boopli keeps it out of backups and never shows it again.
claude.asking_claude_this_can_take_up: Asking Claude. This can take up to a minute…
claude.claude_is_an_extra_next_to: Claude is an extra, next to your Home Assistant agent. Press {t} when you do not trust the agent's answer, when your free agent is down, or when you have no agent. It uses your own Claude account: every ask is one run of your routine. Claude's routines are a research preview, so they can change or stop working. Boopli sends the task text and your answers. If you turned on room notes, the notes of the rooms a task is about go along, and a room interview sends that room's name and its notes. Photos you choose go along too. Never device names, history or location.

home.use_any_chat_you_like_for: Use any chat you like, for example one you can talk to by voice. Boopli sends nothing: you copy and paste yourself, so this works even with AI help switched off.
home.my_whole_home_what_i_found: My whole home: what I found
home.here_are_the_rooms_in_what: Here are the rooms in what you pasted. Change anything that is wrong, and untick a room you do not want. Nothing is saved until you press Save afterwards.
home.what_should_the_ai_know_about: What should the AI know about this room?
home.for_example_dishwasher_is_under_the: For example: Dishwasher is under the counter. The balcony door sticks.
home.tell_boopli_about_your_rooms_so: Tell Boopli about your rooms, so the AI's small steps fit your home. The notes stay in Boopli on your Home Assistant. They only leave inside a request to your own AI agent, and only the notes of the rooms a task is about. Before you send a task, you can see exactly what goes out.
home.send_room_notes_to_the_ai: Send room notes to the AI with my tasks
home.it_replaces_the_notes_you_have: It replaces the notes you have now.
home.it_replaces_the_notes_this_room: It replaces the notes this room has now.
home.ai_help_is_off_so_the: AI help is off, so the notes are not used yet. Turn it on in Settings. Until then you can still write the notes yourself.
home.talk_through_my_whole_home_in: Talk through my whole home in my own chat
home.copy_a_prompt_talk_it_out: Copy a prompt, talk it out by voice or text, paste the result back.
home.you_stopped_waiting_nothing_was_changed: You stopped waiting. Nothing was changed, so you can try again.
home.copying_did_not_work_here_select: Copying did not work here. Select the text in the box and copy it yourself.
home.this_is_what_i_read_from: This is what I read from what you pasted.
home.this_is_what_the_ai_saw: This is what the AI saw in your photos. The photos are already gone.
home.this_is_what_i_would_write: This is what I would write down.
home.the_agent_has_to_be_able: The agent has to be able to read images. If it cannot, you can pick another one for photos in Settings under AI help, Advanced.
home.take_or_pick_up_to_photos: Take or pick up to {MAX_PHOTOS} photos of this room. They go once to the helper you pick below (your AI agent, or Claude), which writes down what it sees. Boopli does not keep them: they are not saved anywhere, and later requests carry only the notes.
home.with_the_chat_when_you_say: {t} with the chat. When you say you are done, it answers with the notes.
home.include_what_i_have_written_so: Include what I have written so far
home.a_few_quick_questions_about_this: A few quick questions about this room.
home.room_talk_it_out_in_your_own_ai_chat: {room}: talk it out in your own AI chat
home.copy_this_and_paste_it: Copy this and paste it into your chat.
home.copy_the_notes_it_gives_back: Copy the notes it gives back and paste them here.
home.nothing_is_saved_until_you_press: Nothing is saved until you press Save afterwards.

ladders.repeat_the_last_nudge_until_i: Repeat the last nudge until I answer
ladders.build_your_own_ladder_of_nudges: Build your own ladder of nudges. For each nudge you choose how long Boopli waits, and exactly which phone, light, speaker or alarm acts, and how loud. A chore uses a ladder when you pick it as its nudge style.
ladders.no_ladders_yet_the_built_in: No ladders yet. The built-in styles work as before.

panel.leave_without_saving_and_they_are: Leave without saving and they are lost.
panel.show_a_board_for_a_screen: Show a board for a screen on the wall
panel.could_not_reach_boopli_is_the: Could not reach Boopli. Is the integration set up?

pet_preview.the_room_grows_with_the_level: The room grows with the level: a water bowl at 1, a food bowl at 2, a bed at 3. Sleepy or hibernating, the pet sleeps in the bed.
pet_preview.has_no_animated_art_yet_so: {label} has no animated art yet, so it shows its emoji.

picture.the_phone_shows_a_fresh_snapshot: The phone shows a fresh snapshot when the nudge arrives.
picture.this_camera_gives_no_picture_right: This camera gives no picture right now.
picture.that_file_is_not_in_the: That file is not in the media folder.
picture.the_picture_could_not_be_loaded: The picture could not be loaded.
picture.that_file_is_not_in_the_2: That file is not in the media folder, or it is not a picture.
picture.a_file_in_home_assistants_media: A file in Home Assistant's media folder (the one you see as "Media"), not the public www folder. Type its name with the folder, for example boopli/pills.jpg.

rung.set_up_a_phone_light_speaker: Set up a phone, light, speaker or alarm device in Settings first. They show up here.
rung.status_light_stays_on_until_you: Status light (stays on until you answer)

schedule_wizard.tap_the_days_it_should_come: Tap the days it should come up. You set the time for each day in the next step.
schedule_wizard.what_time_on_each_day_a: What time on each day? A day can have more than one time. "Same as …" copies the day above.
schedule_wizard.it_comes_back_this_many_days: It comes back this many days after you finished it:
schedule_wizard.the_first_time_and_then_every: The first time, and then every time after you finish:
schedule_wizard.this_is_when_it_comes_up: This is when it comes up next:
schedule_wizard.saving_applies_it_to_the_chore: Saving applies it to the chore right away.
schedule_wizard.using_it_fills_in_the_chores: Using it fills in the chore's form. Save the chore to keep it.
schedule_wizard.after_that_days_after_you_finish: After that: {every_n_days} days after you finish it, at {time}.
schedule_wizard.how_often_should_this_chore: How often should this chore come up?
schedule_wizard.i_start_it_myself_when_i: I start it myself, when I want.
schedule_wizard.pick_the_days_each_day_gets: Pick the days. Each day gets its own time, or several (for example pills in the morning and evening).
schedule_wizard.every_few_days_after_i_finish: Every few days, after I finish
schedule_wizard.it_comes_back_a_number_of: It comes back a number of days after you finished it, for example every 90 days for a filter.

settings.boopli_sends_a_notification_with_done: Boopli sends a notification with Done and Snooze buttons through the Home Assistant app on the phones you turn on.
settings.boopli_blinks_a_light_itself_and: Boopli blinks a light itself and puts it back exactly as it was, or uses it as an indicator lamp that stays on in a color until you are done. Press Test to see what a light really does: lights differ a lot.
settings.a_light_in_your_home_can: A light in your home can follow a few hundred milliseconds. A light that goes through a cloud service needs about a second or more, so find its limit with Test.
settings.nudges_wait_outside_these_times_set: Nudges wait outside these times. Set different hours for each day. A chore can opt out (for example pills).
settings.how_long_the_first_nudge_waits: How long the first nudge waits for your answers (minutes)
settings.for_chores_that_start_by_themselves: For chores that start by themselves and have questions. They start with all steps; this is how long Boopli waits for your answers before it nudges.
settings.after_on_it_boopli_asks_still: After "On it", Boopli asks "still on it?" after (minutes)
settings.when_you_press_on_it_on: When you press "On it" on a nudge, Boopli stays quiet while you work and checks in once after this time.
settings.boopli_can_split_a_task_into: Boopli can split a task into tiny steps with your own Home Assistant AI agent. It is off until you switch it on. Boopli sends nothing by itself: when you use it, the text of the task and your answers go to the agent you choose, and nothing else (no device names, history or location). A cloud agent receives that text, and free models may keep or learn from what they get, so do not type private details. A local agent keeps everything at home.
settings.no_ai_task_agent_found_in: No AI Task agent found in Home Assistant yet. Add one under Settings, Devices and services.
settings.no_phones_with_the_home_assistant: No phones with the Home Assistant app found.
settings.advanced_agent_for_photos_and_the: Advanced: agent for photos, and the prompts Boopli sends
settings.only_used_when_you_describe_a: Only used when you describe a room from photos on the My home screen. Pick an agent whose model can read images. Your normal agent stays as it is.
settings.these_are_the_instructions_given_to: These are the instructions given to the agent. You can change them. Leave a prompt as it is to use the built-in one. The placeholders {task}, {kind}, {known} and {answers} are filled in by Boopli.
settings.prompts_you_copy_into_your_own: Prompts you copy into your own AI chat
settings.these_are_the_texts_the_in: These are the texts the "In my own chat" buttons on My home give you to copy. Boopli fills in {room} (the room name), {names} (your rooms) and {known} (the notes so far, if you tick that). Keep the part that asks for the answer in the same shape: one short fact per line in one code block, and for the whole home a "## Room" heading line before each room. Boopli reads the pasted answer that way.
settings.save_or_discard_your_unsaved_changes: Save or discard your unsaved changes to import.
settings.keep_for_later_closes_this_window: "Keep for later" closes this window and keeps your changes. The card shows an orange "Unsaved" tag.
settings.chat_prompt_for_the_whole_home: Chat prompt for the whole home
settings.no_ladders_of_your_own_yet: No ladders of your own yet.
settings.not_set_boopli_assumes_you_are: Not set. Boopli assumes you are home.
settings.save_your_whole_setup_to_one: Save your whole setup to one file (.adhd), or load one on a new install.
settings.want_to_do_all_of_it: Want to do all of it again from the start?
settings.presence_note: At home Boopli uses everything above. Away, it only uses your phone, and only for chores marked "anywhere".

speakers.no_alexa_devices_entities_found_is: No Alexa Devices entities found. Is the integration installed?
speakers.you_have_no_such_speaker_yet: You have no such speaker yet.
speakers.one_list_for_all_speakers_pick: One list for all speakers. Pick them as the Ding or the Alarm sound, or in your ladders. An Alexa sound plays on Alexa speakers, a file on any speaker.
speakers.one_setting_for_each_kind_of: One setting for each kind of speaker. Another media player can only play files. Which sound plays when is set in Nudge it your way.
speakers.use_chore_for_the_chore_name: Use {chore} for the chore name and {step} for the step. Example: "{chore}: {step}".
speakers.press_a_test_link_to_hear: Press a Test link to hear a speaker. What a speaker plays at which nudge is set in Nudge it your way.
speakers.a_siren_switch_or_script_that: A siren, switch or script that sounds the alarm. Boopli switches it on for the time you set, then off again, and also off when you answer or when Home Assistant restarts.
speakers.no_speaker_yet_press_add_a: No speaker yet. Press Add a speaker.
speakers.choose_a_siren_switch_or_script: Choose a siren, switch or script…
speakers.add_a_speaker_that_can_play: Add a speaker that can play it first.
speakers.sound_library_hint: Pick an id from the {library}, for example amzn_sfx_doorbell_chime_01. Use a Test button to hear it. Some ids stay silent.
speakers.file_in_my_media_folder_for_example: File in my media folder (for example boopli/{example}.mp3)

today.what_do_you_want_to_get: What do you want to get done?
today.boopli_can_split_a_big_task: Boopli can split a big task into tiny steps with your own AI agent. It is switched off until you set it up.
today.when_should_this_part_come_back: When should this part come back?
today.it_started_with_all_its_steps: It started with all its steps. Answer, and the steps you do not need today disappear.
today.nothing_is_lost_the_steps_wait: Nothing is lost. The steps wait as their own small task under “Set aside for later”.
today.boopli_is_not_fully_set_up: Boopli is not fully set up yet.
today.ask_claude_to_break_it_down: Ask Claude to break it down
today.enjoy_the_quiet_what_is_coming: Enjoy the quiet. What is coming up shows below.
today.add_your_first_chore_in_the: Add your first chore in the Chores tab.
today.and_more_in_the_chores_tab: and {length} more in the Chores tab
today.nice_you_got_things_done_today: Nice, you got things done today.

triggers.start_typing_a_name_for_example: Start typing a name, for example door
triggers.not_found_right_now_check_the: Not found right now. Check the name.
triggers.start_typing_a_name_for_example_2: Start typing a name, for example button
triggers.nothing_yet_only_you_finish_this: Nothing yet: only you finish this step (with Done). Add one below to let it finish by itself.
triggers.it_finishes_the_step_when_it: It finishes the step when it…
triggers.and_stays_that_way_for_minutes: …and stays that way for (minutes, 0 = right away)
triggers.off_the_usual_it_has_to: Off (the usual): it has to happen after the step starts, so a door that was already open does not finish "open it to dry". On: good for "windows are shut" or "plant is fine".
triggers.hold_your_phone_to_the_tag: Hold your phone to the tag now…
triggers.only_this_kind_of_press_empty: Only this kind of press (empty = any press)
triggers.also_count_it_if_it_is: Also count it if it is already true when the step starts

wait.this_usually_takes_under_a_minute: This usually takes under a minute.
wait.still_working_free_models_can_be: Still working. Free models can be slow.
wait.still_working_this_one_is_slow: Still working. This one is slow, but it is not stuck.
wait.nearly_at_the_limit_if_there: Nearly at the limit. If there is no answer, you can try again.

wall_edit.the_board_is_a_grid_of: The board is a grid of square cells, scaled to fit the screen. 16 by 9 fits a TV or a tablet lying down.
wall_edit.choose_the_rows_that_make_the: Choose the rows that make the cells square on the screen shown
wall_edit.night_is_when_quiet_hours_are: Night is when quiet hours are on and it is outside the hours of nudging. A tap wakes the board for 30 seconds. While away mode is on, a slim bar shows at the top of the wall. It is not shown here.
wall_edit.drag_to_move_drag_the_corner: Drag to move · drag the corner to resize · tap to change · ✕ to remove
wall_edit.every_cell_of_this_board_is: Every cell of this board is taken. Make the grid bigger or remove a tile.
wall_edit.there_is_no_room_for_that: There is no room for that.
wall_edit.this_grid_cannot_be_made_coarser: This grid cannot be made coarser evenly.
wall_edit.some_tiles_do_not_line_up: Some tiles do not line up with a coarser grid. Move or resize them first.
wall_edit.link_for_the_tablets_start_page: Link for the tablet's start page: {boardLink} (after you save)
wall_edit.show_the_board_in_the_shape: Show the board in the shape of this window
wall_edit.a_tv_or_a_tablet_lying: A TV or a tablet lying down

wall.no_board_yet_make_one_in: No board yet. Make one in Settings, on the Wall board card.

wizard.a_board_is_a_grid_of: A board is a grid of tiles for a screen on the wall: the clock, the pet, what is due, the weather and more.
wizard.a_ladder_is_a_list_of: A ladder is a list of nudges. For each nudge you choose how long Boopli waits, and exactly which devices act and how loud. Start by giving it a name.
wizard.give_the_ladder_a_name_first: Give the ladder a name first.
wizard.what_should_happen_after_the_last: What should happen after the last nudge?
wizard.no_more_nudges_after_the_last: No more nudges after the last one.
wizard.you_pick_a_ladder_for_a: You pick a ladder for a chore in the chore's nudge style.
wizard.boopli_breaks_chores_into_small_steps: Boopli breaks chores into small steps and nudges you with the lights, speakers and phone you already have. A few quick questions, and you can skip any of them. Nothing leaves your home, and nothing is sent to a device until you press a Test button.
wizard.what_should_your_pet_be_called: What should your pet be called?
wizard.no_phone_is_set_up_yet: No phone is set up yet. Skip this.
wizard.how_loud_should_each_phone_be: How loud should each phone be, and from which nudge on? Nudge 1 is the first one for a step. You can leave the defaults.
wizard.should_boopli_stay_quiet_at_certain: Should Boopli stay quiet at certain times, like at night? Set the times Boopli may nudge you for each day on its own. Outside them, nudges wait. A chore can opt out later, for example pills.
wizard.when_you_press_snooze_how_many: When you press Snooze, how many minutes until the next nudge?
wizard.no_reminder_light_is_set_up: No reminder light is set up yet. Skip this.
wizard.fine_tune_each_light_a_light: Fine-tune each light. A light in your home can follow a few hundred milliseconds; a cloud-connected light needs about a second or more, so find its limit with Test.
wizard.this_light_only_goes_on_and: This light only goes on and off, so it has no color.
wizard.a_status_light_has_no_blink: A status light has no blink settings.
wizard.do_you_want_speaker_reminders_a: Do you want speaker reminders? A speaker can play a small ding, say the step out loud, or sound an alarm if you keep ignoring it. You can also use a siren or a switch as an alarm. If you only want lights and your phone, skip this.
wizard.which_speaker_do_you_want_to: Which speaker do you want to set up? You can add more speakers afterwards.
wizard.pick_a_speaker_first_press_back: Pick a speaker first. Press Back.
wizard.the_speaker_says_the_step_out: The speaker says the step out loud, for example "Dishwasher: Empty it".
wizard.optional_a_siren_switch_or_script: Optional: a siren, switch or script that Boopli switches on for a while if you keep ignoring a step, and off again. It also stops when you answer.
wizard.no_alarm_device_is_set_up: No alarm device is set up yet. Skip this.
wizard.how_long_should_each_device_stay: How long should each device stay on, and from which nudge on?
wizard.if_boopli_knows_where_you_are: If Boopli knows where you are, it reminds you with lights and speakers only when you are home, and only on your phone when you are away. This is optional. Without it, Boopli assumes you are home.
wizard.some_chores_to_start_with_untick: Some chores to start with. Untick what you do not want. They are added without a schedule, so nothing nudges you until you set a time (in the Chores tab) or start one yourself.
wizard.boopli_sends_nothing_by_itself_when: Boopli sends nothing by itself. When you use it, the text of the task and your answers go to the agent you choose, and nothing else: no device names, no history, no location. A cloud agent receives that text, and free models may keep or learn from what they get, so do not type private details. A local agent keeps everything at home.
wizard.ai_help_is_off_go_back: AI help is off. Go back to switch it on, or skip this.
wizard.which_ai_agent_should_boopli_use: Which AI agent should Boopli use?
wizard.no_ai_task_agent_found_yet: No AI Task agent found yet. Add one in Home Assistant under Settings, Devices and services, then come back.
wizard.not_interested_press_skip_or_go: Not interested? Press Skip or go to the end. Nothing changes.
wizard.ask_claude_is_off_go_back: Ask Claude is off. Go back to switch it on, or skip this.
wizard.your_home_assistants_address_on_the: your Home Assistant's address on the internet
wizard.claudes_screens_change_now_and_then: Claude's screens change now and then, so a button may be named a little differently.
wizard.paste_the_routines_fire_address_and: Paste the routine's fire address and its token. Then test it.
wizard.the_test_saves_your_settings_first: The test saves your settings first, then asks Claude for a tiny answer.
wizard.next_put_the_tiles_where_you: Next: put the tiles where you want them, on the board itself.
wizard.no_phone_with_the_home_assistant: No phone with the Home Assistant app found. Install the app and sign in, then come back. You can skip this for now.
wizard.how_should_new_chores_nudge_you: How should new chores nudge you, unless you say otherwise?
wizard.add_a_siren_switch_or_script: Add a siren, switch or script…
wizard.press_the_button_to_save_and: Press the button to save and test it, or Next to only save it.
wizard.everything_can_be_changed_again_in: Everything can be changed again in Settings, step by step or in the full forms.
wizard.optional_details_skip_if_the_defaults: Optional details. Skip if the defaults are fine.
wizard.pick_a_speaker_or_press_skip: Pick a speaker, or press Skip.
wizard.give_the_new_board_a_name: Give the new board a name.
wizard.change_its_name_its_nudges_or: Change its name, its nudges or how it ends.
wizard.only_your_own_ladders_can_be: Only your own ladders can be deleted. You have none.
wizard.remove_one_of_your_own_that: Remove one of your own that you do not need any more.
wizard.the_first_nudge_goes_out_right: The first nudge goes out right away. Which devices should act?
wizard.how_long_should_boopli_wait_for: How long should Boopli wait for this nudge, and which devices should act?
wizard.file_in_the_media_folder_or: File in the media folder (or a URL)
wizard.your_browser_did_not_allow_copying: Your browser did not allow copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.
wizard.it_is_used_by_pick_another: It is used by {join}. Pick another nudge style for them first, then come back.
wizard.delete_the_ladder_this_cannot_be: Delete the ladder {name}? This cannot be undone.
wizard.which_phone_should_get_booplis_notificat: Which phone should get Boopli's notifications? They have {t} and {t2} buttons, so you can answer without opening anything.
wizard.which_lights_should_remind_you_each: Which lights should remind you? Each one either {t} when a step is your turn, or is a {t2} that turns on and stays on until you are done. This is optional.
wizard.for_example_boopli_ding_mp3_in: For example boopli/ding.mp3 in your Home Assistant media folder.
wizard.which_nudge_plays_it_is_set: {intro} Which nudge plays it is set in Nudge it your way.
wizard.joins_the_standard_nudges_one_nudge: {fn} joins the standard nudges (One nudge, Escalating, Persistent) the way speakers always did: the ding first, then the spoken sentence, then the alarm. To change which nudge it acts at, open {t} in Settings.
wizard.boopli_can_split_a_big_task: Boopli can split a big task, like "clean my room", into tiny steps. It asks you a few questions first, so the steps fit your situation. This uses {t} Home Assistant AI agent.
wizard.is_an_extra_button_next_to: {t} is an extra button next to the normal one. Use it when you do not trust your agent's answer, when your free agent is down, or when you have no agent at all.
wizard.it_uses_you_make_a_small: It uses {t}: you make a small routine there, and every ask runs it once. Claude calls routines a research preview, so they can change or stop working. Boopli sends the task text and your answers. If you turned on room notes, the notes of the rooms a task is about go along, and a room interview sends that room's name and its notes. Photos you choose to send go along too. Never device names, history or location. You need a Claude account on claude.ai, and Home Assistant must be reachable from the internet, so Claude can send the answer back.
wizard.do_this_once_on_claude_ai: Do this once on claude.ai, under Routines:
wizard.make_a_new_routine_name_it: Make a new routine. Name it {t}.
wizard.add_an_to_the_routine_and: Add an {t} to the routine, and press {t2}. Copy the token now: Claude shows it only once.
wizard.leave_every_connector_gmail_calendar_and: Leave every connector (Gmail, calendar and so on) switched {t}. The routine does not need them.
wizard.link_for_the_tablets_start_page: Link for the tablet's start page: {value}
wizard.hold_nudges_outside_the_times_below: Hold nudges outside the times below
wizard.the_sentence_chore_and_step_are: The sentence ({chore} and {step} are filled in)
wizard.a_short_friendly_sound_the_gentlest: A short, friendly sound, the gentlest reminder.
wizard.a_loud_sound_that_repeats_for: A loud sound that repeats for a while, for when a step keeps being ignored.
wizard.this_ladder_has_nudges_one: This ladder has {count} nudge so far. Add another one, or are you done?
wizard.this_ladder_has_nudges_other: This ladder has {count} nudges so far. Add another one, or are you done?
wizard.amazon_sound_hint: Pick a sound from the {library}. The id is amzn_sfx_ plus the sound's name in lower case with underscores and a two-digit number, for example amzn_sfx_doorbell_chime_01. Some sounds stay silent on some Echo devices, so press Test.
wizard.make_an_environment: Make an environment for it with network access Limited, and allow this address:
wizard.home_assistant_address_unknown: your Home Assistant's address on the internet. Home Assistant does not know it yet: set the external URL in Home Assistant, or fill in the address under Ask Claude in the next screen.
wizard.what_do_you_want_to_do: What do you want to do?
wizard.only_shown_in_boopli_never_nudges: Only shown in Boopli, never nudges.
